title: College Canteen - AJAY KUMAR GARG ENGINEERING COLLEGE

blocks.text: The college canteen is one of the liveliest areas of the campus. It aims at providing high-quality and nutritious food and always strives to follow high standards of cleanliness. A wide variety of food items and beverages are available at very nominal rates. The campus has 2 food outlets situated at Mechanical and CS-IT blocks respectively. Canteens remain open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on all working days including Saturdays.

text:
COLLEGE CANTEEN


The college canteen is one of the liveliest areas of the campus. It aims at providing high-quality and nutritious food and always strives to follow high standards of cleanliness. A wide variety of food items and beverages are available at very nominal rates. The campus has 2 food outlets situated at Mechanical and CS-IT blocks respectively. Canteens remain open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on all working days including Saturdays.
